recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the conformance portion of FHIR-31082 without pre-applying unresolved FHIR-49968 wording changes; revisit expression/reference prose only when that later tracker reaches a final Applied/Published state.
issue_request: FHIR-31082 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to resolve Expression.language being required while Expression.expression/reference were optional by making Expression.language 0..1, adding an invariant that language must be present if Expression.expression or Expression.reference are present, and clarifying that expression may name content inside referenced material when both expression and reference are present.
initial_application: Git history contains explicit FHIR-31082 commits 3d9ca6b48c19375838c5828d401259b44d9fea3a and 21448ecd9ec6a665f914564d2dac103c1e341a73, which added the expression/reference clarification text but did not implement the approved language invariant. The related FHIR-27029 commit 272e3fb71ea5f6b0f3be0fbf318c3f3f8e081d5e later changed Expression.language to 0..1 and added authoring guidance, leaving the old expression/reference-required invariant in place.
additional_context: Expression is active in source/fhir.ini as a metadata datatype, metadata type page entry, normative type, and abbreviation. FHIR-27029 is a final same-artifact decision supporting authoring-time description-only Expression content. FHIR-49968 is a later same-artifact issue about Expression.expression/reference wording, but it is Waiting for Input and was not safe to apply in this run.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/expression.xml so the first Expression invariant now requires language when expression or reference is present, with matching FHIRPath and XPath. Also corrected the adjacent name invariant XPath so the removed expression/reference requirement does not persist under the wrong invariant.
source_changes: source/datatypes/expression.xml: replaced the stale 'expression or reference must be provided' invariant with '(expression.exists() or reference.exists()) implies language.exists()' and a matching XPath.
source/datatypes/expression.xml: corrected the XPath for the existing name-format invariant so the old expression/reference requirement is not retained in the XPath column.
